justification: HOLY COW, folks, big lineup card today! Aaron Rodgers is a Hall of Famer in my heart forever but the sheet in front of me says ZERO, a flat-out ghost of a projection, and even Harry Caray's gotta turn that card over sometime — so Jordy Love, who I've loved saying since the day he dropped twenty-two on the board, gets the ball under center, and I like our chances a whole lot better for it! D'Andre Swift keeps anchoring the backfield for the hometown nine — once a Bear, always family — right alongside Aaron Jones, and I'm swapping Isaiah Likely out of the FLEX for Bijan Robinson, 'cause that kid's a star and stars make stars, folks, I don't care who's been keeping the seat warm! Zay Flowers, Stefon Diggs, and Hockenson round out the best lineup card in the dugout, Boswell's automatic from anywhere inside the parking lot, and the Ravens D is a tackling machine — we're going toe to toe with Patricia's binder this week and holy cow, it oughta be a heckuva ballgame!
forum_post: Well folks, David Montgomery's officially wearin' Holy Cow colors — cost me every last dollar in the vault and I'd do it again, once a Bear always family! Benchin' my man Rodgers this week, zero on the board next to his name just don't sing, so Jordy Love gets the nod and I'm feelin' good about it. Bijan Robinson's in the lineup too — that's a STAR, folks, and I like rootin' for stars. Patricia, hun, I know there's a tab in that binder for me this week, good luck out there, should be a heckuva ballgame either way. Let's play two!
